Thanks Marissa — great demo. A few clarifications from our AP side:

- AP policy: For any vendor where the expected monthly spend is > $10k, we require an approved PO before the first invoice. For < $10k we can use a corporate card while vendor onboarding occurs.
- Vendor onboarding: Our vendor team needs a completed W-9 (or W-8BEN for non-US entities), proof of SOC2 (Type II preferred), and the vendor questionnaire filled out. That normally takes 5-10 business days once we have the docs.
- Marketplace: We do prefer marketplace billing for some teams because it allows consolidated invoicing, but not all procurement teams will accept marketplace-only contracts. If Redwood can invoice via AWS Marketplace and also offer direct PO invoicing, that'd be ideal.

Questions:
1) Can you provide SOC2 report + vendor questionnaire answers?
2) Do you accept PO-based invoicing net 30? Any minimums?

I can loop in our vendor onboarding lead if that helps.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee

Thanks Samantha — really helpful. Quick answers and suggested path:

- SOC2 / questionnaire: Attaching a link to our SOC2 summary and the vendor questionnaire answers (attached as a completed spreadsheet). If you need the full SOC2 Type II report we'll route that through your security contact (NDA/CMA required in some cases).
- PO invoicing: We do support direct PO invoicing net 30. No formal minimums on our side for monthly spend, but finance teams sometimes set internal thresholds (which you noted).
- Marketplace: We can support AWS Marketplace invoicing which will appear on your AWS bill, or direct PO invoicing from Redwood. We can do both — marketplace for convenience and PO for teams that require vendor onboarding evidence.

Suggested go-forward: If you want to start quickly, we typically recommend a short pilot on card billing (1 month) while FinOps completes vendor onboarding. Once vendor is approved we convert to PO invoicing and backdate/credit as needed for the pilot month if required. This keeps the project moving and keeps spend visible.

I've attached: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx and SOC2_Summary.pdf. If you want the full SOC2 report we can make it available to your security team.
